[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended films for black-and-white photography:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Ilford HP5 Plus 400: Classic, all-purpose film with wide exposure latitude.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Kodak Tri-X 400: High-contrast film with distinctive grain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Agfa APX 400: Fine-grain film with neutral tone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Fuji Neopan Acros 100: High-resolution film with wide tonal range.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested understanding the Sunny 16 Rule for exposure estimation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using the Zone System for controlling contrast in images.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended shooting during the golden hour for warm, soft light.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using reflective surfaces and shade to manage lighting conditions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised getting familiar with the camera's limitations and quirks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended using a light meter for measuring light.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested experimenting with different development techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended scanning or printing negatives for best results.
